# `jouet wait file`

- **Usage:** `jouet wait file [--contains <REGEX>] [--gone] <PATH>`

Wait for a file to exist, contain a match, or be gone

## Arguments
- **`<PATH>`** — The file (or directory) to watch

## Flags
- **`--contains <REGEX>`** — Wait until a line of the file matches REGEX, and print that line
- **`--gone`** — Wait until nothing exists at PATH
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
